text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days and no MDE/power","detail":"A 1-week run is below the 14-day minimum, and storms are sporadic so a week may have few or no storm events. No MDE, power calculation, or sample size is given.","evidence_quote":"Run for 1 week. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Run at least 14 days (likely longer to capture sufficient storm exposure), and specify MDE, power, and required sample size."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Randomization by customer can leak between arms","detail":"Storm conditions are geographic and drivers/routes serve multiple customers, so customer-level randomization shares capacity and routes across arms, creating interference. Widened windows for some customers affect routing for others.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by customer.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomize at a geographic or zone/route level (or use switchback by region-time) to avoid cross-arm leakage."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Customer experience guardrails absent","detail":"Widening promise windows changes customer-facing delivery commitments, yet only cost is guarded. Metrics such as customer satisfaction, order conversion/cancellation, and window-adherence or contact rate are missing.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as conversion/checkout rate, cancellation rate, customer satisfaction/CSAT, and support contact rate, with thresholds."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Prior experiment referenced without learnings","detail":"The proposal cites EXP-014 but does not state what it found or why that outcome supports this variant. It only says this narrows scope.","evidence_quote":"Follows EXP-014, but only applies during storms rather than permanently.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Summarize EXP-014's results and explain how they inform the hypothesis and design here."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Baseline and source not verifiable","detail":"The 78% baseline is stated as fact without a source, and the problem cites an analysis without quantification or a link.","evidence_quote":"baseline 78%, target 88% within 8 weeks","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the data source and date range for the 78% baseline and link the weather impact analysis."},{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Cost guardrail lacks a threshold and storm definition is vague","detail":"\"Must not increase\" has no tolerance or measurement window, and \"severe weather\"/\"storms\" is not defined, so the success metric scope is ambiguous.","evidence_quote":"On-Time Delivery Rate during storms","citations":[],"recommendation":"Define the storm/severe weather criteria (e.g., NWS alert level) and set a numeric guardrail tolerance and measurement window."}]}
